sloganShort: Every dollar of debt you owe, turned into a war chest ready to deploy the moment opportunity arises.
status: Patent-pending. 15 core applications in process, 75 more underway.
declarations: Nowhere else will you find anything remotely close to what is on this page. Not half as good. Not twenty percent as good. Two or three percent, on a good day.
By our own measure we are fifteen years ahead of MoneyGuidePro, eMoney, RightCapital, NaviPlan and Orion Planning. They model a plan. We build a system that runs one.
Unlike medicine, we do not need clinical trials to slow an idea down. When a better strategy appears, we put it into your plan at the speed of thought.
You already have the money, the attorneys and the consultants. What you have never had is one system that sees all of it at once and moves every piece in the right order.

In your first week here you will learn things about your own money that ten, fifteen or twenty years of high-fee advisory relationships never explained, because they measured two or three percent of what we measure.
You will tell five to ten colleagues about this site. Not because we ask. Because you will not be able to help it.
expect: One machine, not a stack of advisors. Every calculator we own snaps to a single base, so a mortgage decision, a Roth conversion and a practice choice are never planned in isolation again.
Your debt treated as an asset. Every dollar you owe is modelled as borrowing power, sequenced against taxes, so it becomes liquidity you can deploy instead of interest you surrender.
Evidence beside every estimate. The forward projection the law requires, and beside it the historical record of how the same strategy actually behaved, decade by decade.
Protection designed before anything happens. Divorce, lawsuit and creditor exposure mapped under your own state's rules, while it can still be changed.
Perfectionism as a standard. We are not here to win your business. We are here to win it by leaps, bounds and dimensions you will measure in the first week.
founderMessage: I'm Sam Russell. I built this because every physician I have ever sat across from had the money, the attorneys and the consultants, and still had never seen their whole financial life in one place, moving as one system. That is what this is. Fifteen patent-pending engines that treat every dollar you owe as a war chest, sequence your taxes for a lifetime, and prove the plan before you commit to it. Nobody else has it. Not half of it. Not twenty percent of it. Read the fifteen claims below. It takes ten minutes. Then decide for yourself.

claims.name: HELOC-to-IUL Arbitrage Optimization Engine
claims.lead: Imagine you could borrow money from a piggy bank at a low price, say three cents per dollar, and put it into a specialized liquidity tool that grows at, say, seven cents per dollar.
claims.detail: This invention figures out the best way to borrow from your house, a HELOC, and move that money into a specialized liquidity tool that earns interest on the highest-watermark account value as a rule, and never on the smaller amount of money you leave in the account. That way you can take the liquidity out to pay off your mortgage in five to seven years without spending an extra dollar, then do it again the next time, while securing a tax-free income stream that grows exponentially for the rest of your life on a negligible cash value and on top of an enormous account value. All monies placed in the account and all interest earned in the account equal the account value. One of our partners has returned forty-five percent four times in the last six years, and we have the paperwork to prove it.

claims.name: Cascading Multi-Calculator Financial Planning Engine
claims.lead: Thirty-five different financial calculators snap together on one base. Change one number in one place, like your income, and everything connected to it changes with it, automatically.
claims.detail: Your income moves the retirement calculator. The retirement calculator moves the tax calculator, which in turn moves the mortgage-payoff calculator, which affects the next-home-purchase calculator, which flows straight into your passive income. Everything is connected together.

claims.name: AI Whisper Coaching System for Financial Advisors
claims.lead: Imagine giving a book report in front of the class with a super-smart invisible friend whispering in your ear: "They look confused, try explaining it differently," or "Great job, now mention the cool part."
claims.detail: This invention is that invisible, super-smart friend for financial advisors during real client meetings. Thirteen AIs listen to the conversation, notice when the client is confused, worried, or asking a tough question, and whisper suggestions to the advisor in real time. They predict the client's objections five to ten minutes before they arrive and produce the calculations, strategies, and printouts that answer them, so the results can be shown, printed, or emailed before the question is even asked.

claims.name: Wealth Genome Scoring and Classification System
claims.lead: Just like your DNA is a unique code that makes you who you are, your "Wealth Genome" is the unique financial code based on twenty-plus factors about your money life.
claims.detail: This invention reads your financial DNA, your income, debts, family size, risk comfort level, job type, age, health, and more, and gives you a special score that tells your financial advisor exactly which strategies will work best for you. It is like the sorting hat from Harry Potter, but instead of picking your Hogwarts house, it picks your perfect financial plan.

claims.name: Tax-Free Retirement Income Waterfall Engine
claims.lead: When you retire, you have money in lots of different buckets: your Roth IRA, regular IRA, Social Security, a pension, rental income, life insurance, annuity income. The government taxes each bucket differently.
claims.detail: This invention is like a master plumber who connects all your money buckets with pipes and valves, then figures out the perfect order to turn each valve so you pay the absolute least amount of taxes over your retirement, potentially saving hundreds of thousands or even millions of dollars.

claims.name: Divorce Asset Protection Calculator with Irrevocable Trust and IUL Shielding
claims.lead: Imagine you have a treasure chest, and you are worried someone might try to take half of it. This invention is like a special lock that shows you how to move your treasure into a perfectly protected vault before anyone can claim it.
claims.detail: It knows the protection laws for all fifty states and can model up to five different what-if divorce scenarios to show you exactly how much of your money would be safe versus exposed.

claims.name: Behavioral Lock-In Prevention System
claims.lead: You know how sometimes you really want to buy a toy just because your friend has one, even though you do not actually need it? Adults have the same pattern with their money.
claims.detail: This invention is like a brain scanner for financial decisions. It detects when someone is about to make an emotionally charged decision and sell at a loss because of a brain trick. Our system reaches out to them in advance, shows them evidence of the real numbers, and helps them take a week or a month off from selling, digest the history of what has happened before, and think clearly.

claims.name: Mortgage Elimination Through Real Estate Recycling and IUL Arbitrage
claims.lead: Imagine your house has a hundred thousand dollars of equity sitting in it. This invention shows you how to pull that equity out, put it into a magic growing jar, let it grow, and use the growth to pay off your mortgage faster.
claims.detail: Then you do it again with the new equity, like a snowball rolling downhill getting bigger and bigger. You can do this every five to seven years, over and over and over again. Later on you can run two of them at a time, and your growth goes exponential.

claims.name: Time Machine Dual-Illustration Method
claims.lead: Insurance companies are only allowed to show you imaginary future numbers, because of strict federal rules called AG49. The Time Machine shows you the true returns.
claims.detail: You see what actually would have happened if you had bought the policy ten, twenty, or thirty years ago, using real market history, right beside the illustration the rules require. The imaginary future and the real past, side by side, so you make a much smarter decision.

claims.name: One Hundred Percent Roth Conversion in Twelve Months with One Hundred Percent Tax Offset Strategy Engine
claims.lead: Converting your retirement money from a regular IRA to a Roth IRA is smart, because a Roth grows tax-free forever. But you have to pay a big tax bill when you convert, and this invention found a clever trick.
claims.detail: You can use special tax deductions, tax depreciation and tax credits, from a hundred different options, to cancel out the tax bill from the Roth conversion completely. It is like using one receipt to pay for another purchase. The assets' tax benefits pay for the Roth conversion's tax cost and refund the amount back to you within twelve months, legally, ninety-nine percent of the time.

claims.name: FIA Collateral Assignment Lending Optimization System
claims.lead: Imagine you have a piggy bank that you can split into two sections. One section, the bigger one, about seventy percent, you can use as collateral to borrow money from a bank. The other section, about thirty percent, generates income for you.
claims.detail: This invention figures out the perfect way to split a fixed indexed annuity into a collateral sleeve and an income sleeve, then models exactly how much of it you can borrow against and when. It shows how to combine it with oil and gas investments for long-term income and tax deductions that remove your taxes, whether they are capital gains from a 1031 exchange, W-2 federal taxes, capital gains taxes, or the taxes from IRA conversions.

claims.name: Top Ten Ecological Drivers of Retirement Success and Risk-Failure Assessment Framework
claims.lead: According to the Social Security Administration, the IRS, the Bureau of Labor Statistics and Morningstar, there are ten threats to your retirement, and ninety percent of the time your financial adviser has never discussed them with you.
claims.detail: The top ten threats are uncorrelated with your average rate of return, or with how consistent your average rates of return are. The top ten threats make the average rate of return meaningless. Literally meaningless. You need to know what the top ten threats are, according to the government, because they know what they are, and you need to know too. It is not the average rate of return.

claims.name: Monte Carlo Simulation Engine with IUL Floor and Cap Constraints
claims.lead: Imagine you want to know if your umbrella will keep you dry, so you test it in ten thousand different rainstorms: light drizzle, heavy downpour, sideways wind, everything.
claims.detail: This invention does the same thing with your life insurance cash value policy. It runs ten thousand what-if scenarios using random stock market conditions to see how your IUL policy performs in the best case, the worst case, and everything in between. But here is the special part. It knows that most IUL policies have a floor, so you can never lose money even when the market crashes, and many of them have a cap, so your gains are limited, which makes the math completely different from normal investments.

claims.name: Debt-to-War-Chest Sequencer
claims.lead: Every dollar you owe is modelled as borrowing power and sequenced against your taxes, so debt becomes liquidity you can deploy instead of interest you surrender.
claims.detail: The war chest is not a loan. It is the order in which your existing obligations, equity and tax position are arranged so capital is waiting when opportunity arrives.

claims.name: Automated Advisor Practice Revenue and Territory Strategy Platform
claims.lead: Imagine you are running a lemonade stand and you have a super-smart robot assistant that does eight different jobs for you.
claims.detail: It predicts how much money you will make next month, shows you the best street corners to set up on, lets you practice your sales pitch with an AI customer, checks what competing stands are charging, finds new customers, reminds you to call back customers who have not bought in a while, shows you a timeline of all your income, and sends you alerts when something important happens. This invention is that robot assistant for financial advisors running their entire business.
